Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家。孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了。在那个城市，孟母从早到晚都找工作，可是找不到，害得孟母没有钱。难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房。他们搬了到别一个城市找工作。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代的时候，孟子和孟母住了在靠墓地的家：在古代，better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears；住在靠近墓地的地方/墓地附近，delete了，在+Place
- 孩子才五岁就每天在墓地祭拜了：孟子，孩子is vague and unclear
- 难怪她跟孩子搬家，原来买不了房：wrong information, 搬家因为孟母觉得it is not good to imitate how to offer sacrifices
- 他们搬了到别一个城市找工作：搬到了，另外一个城市，“别（的）” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”, whereas “另外“ is for “addition in quantity”, and “another, the other”

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代的时候：在古代，This phrase redundantly combines a historical time period with a “time of” expression; use the shorter time expression. [vocab list]
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 住了在靠墓地的家：住在靠墓地的家里，A continuing living state uses no 了, and 住 takes 在 before its location phrase. [rule: location_zai_place]
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 跟孩子搬家：带着孩子搬家，Use 带着 to show that the mother takes her child with her when moving; 跟 means “with” and does not express this action clearly here. [vocab list]
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 搬了到：搬到了，Put 了 after the resultative/directional part of the verb phrase, not between 搬 and 到. [teacher rule: le_placement]
5. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 别一个城市：另一个城市，Use 另一个 for one additional or different city; 别 is used in forms such as 别人 or 别的 to distinguish others from the one being discussed. [teacher rule: bieren]
6. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 孩子才五岁：他才五岁，孟子 was named in the immediately preceding sentence and no other child competes as the referent, so a pronoun is natural for a close re-occurrence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
7. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 在那个城市：在他们住的城市，The city has not previously been introduced, so 那个 does not have a clear antecedent; use a full noun phrase to identify it. [rule: ambiguous_reference]
8. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 害得孟母没有钱：害得她没有钱，孟母 has already been named at the start of this sentence and no competing female character appears, so use a pronoun for this close re-occurrence. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
9. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 每天在墓地祭拜了：每天在墓地祭拜，A routine marked by 每天 uses the zero particle, not completed-action 了. [rule: aspect_le_completed]

items.reason: 古代和的时候重复表示时间，按老师的规则应改为在古代。
住表示状态时不加了，并且地点应放在在后面。
跟孩子搬家本身语法正确，也能清楚表示母亲和孩子一起搬家。
了不能放在搬和到之间，应说搬到了。
这里表示另一个城市，应使用另一个而不是别一个。
孩子指代不够明确；孟子刚出现过，用他可以清楚指代孟子。
那个城市没有已知的指称对象，在他们住的城市能明确说明是哪座城市。
孟母在同一句前面刚被提到，按近距离重复指称规则应使用她。
每天表示日常、重复的行为，不能用完成体了。
